mission.author: NellsRelo
mission.description:
Techne, Byron,

You've done well in investigating the Crystallized Rift. I'll send some Warmages in to study it more closely. We've detected more anomalous Rift energy, this time in a fortress used for sourcing material for our Acid traps. I trust you to figure out what's happening. Be cautious, apprentices stationed there have recently heard strange noises coming from below.

- Gabriella
mission.title: Acid Factory

added.name: NorthWingsIntro
added.source:
"""North Wings' opening (user 2026-10-30), for a campaign launch only.

When the first wave starts (the first build phase is over), the rift flickers red, a white flash
fills the screen with an explosion and a camera shake, and as it clears the rift has become the
Crystal (Crystal Defense's BP_Crystal, found by its actor tag). Until then the Crystal is
concealed through its own API (CrystalDefense_P f510b5d9): `Conceal()` on the server once its tag
is on, `Reveal()` while the screen is white. Concealed replicates; on every machine the Crystal is
then hidden, without collision, silent and unlit, takes no hits, and shows the map's rift with the
rift base as shipped. Launched from Custom Maps, in Endless or in Scramble the level plays as it
does without this actor: the Crystal stands from the start.

The two calls go through a timer by function name (K2_SetTimer on the Crystal), so this script
needs no compile-time view of the Crystal's class: bpkit's type data has none for a mod's
Blueprint.

The server decides whether this is a campaign launch (Mode, replicated): the difficulty is not
Endless, the game is not in Scramble, and the current campaign's mission list holds the current
mission (Custom Maps plays from Old Friends' campaign, which does not list it). Every machine then
plays the opening itself when its own copy of the game state shows the first wave begun, so each
player sees, hears and feels it, while the Crystal's own Concealed flag reveals it everywhere. A
machine that first sees the game in a later wave (a late join) plays nothing.

The timings, looks and sounds below are the opening's settings; the mission record's
`settings` on this item replace any of them by name.
"""

Rift = Blueprint("/Game/Environments/Shared/BP_OMDRift.BP_OMDRift_C")
Shake = Blueprint("/Game/Proto/FX/CameraShake/CameraShake_VorwickRiftOpen_Local.CameraShake_VorwickRiftOpen_Local_C")

# -- settings ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CrystalTag: str = "CrystalDefenseCrystal"   # Crystal Defense's tag on its crystal
RiftReach: float = 1500.0          # the map rift the Crystal replaces: the nearest within this (uu)
FlickerSeconds: float = 3.0        # the rift flickers red this long once the first wave starts
FlickerStep: float = 0.06          # one flicker frame (s)
FlickerFirst: float = 0.15         # the share of red frames as the flicker begins; it rises to all
SolidRedSeconds: float = 0.5       # the flicker's last part: red throughout (s)
FlashInSeconds: float = 0.1        # the screen turns white this fast (s)
FlashHoldSeconds: float = 0.2      # and stays white this long; the Crystal takes the rift's place (s)
FlashOutSeconds: float = 1.6       # then clears this slowly (s)
FlashRed: float = 1.0             # the flash's colour (linear, 0..1)
FlashGreen: float = 0.92
FlashBlue: float = 0.9
ShakeScale: float = 1.0            # CameraShake_VorwickRiftOpen_Local (0.7 s) times this
RumbleVolume: float = 0.8          # the red rift's pre-spawn rumble under the flicker
BlastVolume: float = 1.0           # the explosion at the flash
BurstScale: float = 0.3            # the red rift's burst (FX_RedRift_Lvl18_Explode) at the map rift's
                                   # size: its sheet is 750 uu, Scenario 18's red rift's 2500
BurstSpeed: float = 2.6            # the burst plays this many times faster: its particles live 5.0 s
                                   # (measured), so 1.92 s, ending as the white clears (1.9 s after
                                   # the flash starts); its brightest part (the lightning light,
                                   # brightest at 0.355 of its life) peaks 0.68 s in, as the white fades
BurstSeconds: float = 2.0          # and is removed this long after the flash starts, whatever is left
LightIntensity: float = 10.0       # the red light on the rift's red frames (BP_Crystal's own light)
LightRadius: float = 2500.0
SheetMaterial: str = "Mi_RiftBack_Perf"     # the map rift's sheet (FX_VectorField allinOneRift)
CallDelay: float = 0.01            # the Crystal's Conceal / Reveal run this soon (a timer; 0 would clear it)
WaitStep: float = 0.25             # seconds between looks at the game state while waiting

# -- state -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Mode: Replicated[int]              # 0 not decided yet, 1 a campaign launch (the opening plays), 2 not
Stage: int = 0                     # 0 waiting, 1 Crystal found (concealed), 2 flicker, 3 flash, 4 done
SawBreak: bool = False
Began: float = 0.0
Crystal: Actor
Map: Actor
Sheet: MaterialInstanceDynamic
BlueCentre: LinearColor
BlueFlare: LinearColor
BlueOuter: LinearColor
Glow: PointLightComponent
Rumble: AudioComponent
Burst: ParticleSystemComponent


@override
def ReceiveBeginPlay():
    super().ReceiveBeginPlay()
    self.SetActorTickInterval(self.WaitStep)


@override
def ReceiveTick(DeltaSeconds: float):
    if self.Stage == 2:
        self.Flicker()
        return
    if self.Stage == 3:
        if GetGameTimeInSeconds(self) - self.Began >= self.FlickerSeconds + self.FlashInSeconds + self.FlashHoldSeconds:
            self.Reveal(True)
        return
    if self.Mode == 0:
        if IsServer(self):
            self.Decide()
        return
    if self.Mode != 1:
        self.SetActorTickEnabled(False)
        return
    if self.Stage == 0:
        self.Conceal()
        if self.Stage == 0:
            return
    Game = cast(OMDGameState, GetGameState(self))
    if not IsValid(Game):
        return
    if Game.bIsGoBreakActive or Game.bIsTimedBreakActive:
        self.SawBreak = True
        return
    if self.SawBreak:
        if Game.CurrentWave >= 1:
            self.Begin()
        return
    # no build phase seen: the first wave running (its enemies out) still opens; a later one
    # means this machine came in late
    if Game.CurrentWave > 1:
        self.Reveal(False)
    elif Game.EnemiesSpawned > 0:
        self.Begin()


def Decide():
    """On the server: whether this is a campaign launch (Mode 1) or not (Mode 2)."""
    Game = cast(OMDGameInstance, GetGameInstance(self))
    if not IsValid(Game):
        return
    OMDDifficultyBlueprintLibrary.GetGameDifficulty(Current)
    if Current == EGameDifficulty.Endless:
        self.Mode = 2
        return
    if Game.IsInRandomModeCampaign():
        self.Mode = 2
        return
    Listed = Game.GetCurrentMissionList()
    if Listed.contains(Game.CurrentMission):
        self.Mode = 1
    else:
        self.Mode = 2


def Conceal():
    """Once the Crystal is up (its tag is set at its BeginPlay): the map rift under it found (the
    flicker's), and on the server the Crystal told to conceal itself. Stage 1 when done."""
    GetAllActorsWithTag(self, self.CrystalTag, Found)
    if len(Found) == 0:
        return
    self.Crystal = Found[0]
    if IsServer(self):
        K2_SetTimer(self.Crystal, "Conceal", self.CallDelay, False)
    Best = self.RiftReach
    GetAllActorsOfClass(self, Rift, Rifts)
    for Other in Rifts:
        Far = Other.GetDistanceTo(self.Crystal)
        if Far < Best:
            Best = Far
            self.Map = Other
    self.Stage = 1


def Begin():
    """The first wave has started: the flicker begins, with the red rift's rumble under it."""
    self.Stage = 2
    self.Began = GetGameTimeInSeconds(self)
    self.SetActorTickInterval(self.FlickerStep)
    if IsValid(self.Map):
        Shown = cast(Rift, self.Map)
        Count = Shown.RiftFX.GetNumMaterials()
        for I in range(Count):
            Was = Shown.RiftFX.GetMaterial(I)
            if IsValid(Was) and not IsValid(self.Sheet):
                if GetObjectName(Was) == self.SheetMaterial:
                    self.Sheet = Shown.RiftFX.CreateDynamicMaterialInstance(I, Was, "None")
        if IsValid(self.Sheet):
            self.BlueCentre = self.Sheet.K2_GetVectorParameterValue("ColorRiftCenter")
            self.BlueFlare = self.Sheet.K2_GetVectorParameterValue("ColorFlare")
            self.BlueOuter = self.Sheet.K2_GetVectorParameterValue("ColorOuterRift")
        Where = MakeTransform(MakeVector(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), MakeRotator(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), MakeVector(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
        self.Glow = cast(PointLightComponent, self.AddComponentByClass(PointLightComponent, True, Where, False))
        self.Glow.SetMobility(EComponentMobility.Movable)
        self.Glow.K2_SetWorldLocation(Shown.RiftFX.K2_GetComponentLocation(), False, Moved, False)
        self.Glow.bUseInverseSquaredFalloff = False
        self.Glow.SetLightFalloffExponent(2.0)
        self.Glow.SetAttenuationRadius(self.LightRadius)
        # BP_Crystal's light colour (Crystal Defense mode.yaml objective.light.colour 255, 40, 30)
        self.Glow.SetLightColor(LinearColor(1.0, 0.157, 0.118, 1.0), True)
        self.Glow.SetCastShadows(False)
        self.Glow.SetIntensity(0.0)
    self.Rumble = SpawnSound2D(self, Asset("SoundCue'/Game/Sounds/Cinematics/S18_EndGame/CINE_S18_Vorwick_Pre_RiftSpawn_SC.CINE_S18_Vorwick_Pre_RiftSpawn_SC'"), self.RumbleVolume, 1.0, 0.0, None, False, True)


def Flicker():
    """One flicker frame: red or the rift's own blue, red ever more often, then red throughout;
    at the flicker's end, the flash."""
    Elapsed = GetGameTimeInSeconds(self) - self.Began
    if Elapsed >= self.FlickerSeconds:
        self.Flash()
        return
    Rising = self.FlickerSeconds - self.SolidRedSeconds
    Share = 1.0
    if Rising > 0.0 and Elapsed < Rising:
        Share = self.FlickerFirst + (1.0 - self.FlickerFirst) * (Elapsed / Rising)
    self.Tint(RandomFloat() < Share)


def Tint(Red: bool):
    """The rift's sheet and the light: red, or the rift's own colours and dark."""
    if IsValid(self.Sheet):
        if Red:
            # Scenario 18's red rift sheet (Mi_RiftRed_Lvl18, the map rift's parent material)
            self.Sheet.SetVectorParameterValue("ColorRiftCenter", LinearColor(15.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0))
            self.Sheet.SetVectorParameterValue("ColorFlare", LinearColor(15.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0))
            self.Sheet.SetVectorParameterValue("ColorOuterRift", LinearColor(0.3, 0.05, 0.2, 0.0))
        else:
            self.Sheet.SetVectorParameterValue("ColorRiftCenter", self.BlueCentre)
            self.Sheet.SetVectorParameterValue("ColorFlare", self.BlueFlare)
            self.Sheet.SetVectorParameterValue("ColorOuterRift", self.BlueOuter)
    if IsValid(self.Glow):
        if Red:
            self.Glow.SetIntensity(self.LightIntensity)
        else:
            self.Glow.SetIntensity(0.0)


def Flash():
    """The screen turns white and holds, the blast sounds, the cameras shake and the red rift bursts."""
    self.Stage = 3
    self.Tint(True)
    self.Fade(0.0, 1.0, self.FlashInSeconds, True)
    PlaySound2D(self, Asset("SoundCue'/Game/Traps/FallingBoomBarrel/Audio/FallingBB_Explosion_SC.FallingBB_Explosion_SC'"), self.BlastVolume, 1.0, 0.0, None, None, True)
    PlaySound2D(self, Asset("SoundCue'/Game/Trinkets/CyclopeanGaze/Audio/Trinket_CyclopeanGaze_UG_AOE_Explosion_SC.Trinket_CyclopeanGaze_UG_AOE_Explosion_SC'"), self.BlastVolume, 1.0, 0.0, None, None, True)
    if IsValid(self.Rumble):
        self.Rumble.FadeOut(self.FlashOutSeconds, 0.0, EAudioFaderCurve.Linear)
    GetAllActorsOfClass(self, PlayerController, Players)
    for Each in Players:
        Player = cast(PlayerController, Each)
        if IsValid(Player):
            if Player.IsLocalController() and IsValid(Player.PlayerCameraManager):
                Player.PlayerCameraManager.StartCameraShake(Shake, self.ShakeScale, ECameraShakePlaySpace.CameraLocal, MakeRotator(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    if IsValid(self.Map):
        Shown = cast(Rift, self.Map)
        self.Burst = SpawnEmitterAtLocation(Asset("ParticleSystem'/Game/Proto/FX/Rift/FX_RedRift_Lvl18_Explode.FX_RedRift_Lvl18_Explode'"), Shown.RiftFX.K2_GetComponentLocation(), MakeRotator(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), MakeVector(self.BurstScale, self.BurstScale, self.BurstScale))
        if IsValid(self.Burst):
            self.Burst.CustomTimeDilation = self.BurstSpeed
            K2_SetTimer(self, "EndBurst", self.BurstSeconds, False)


def EndBurst():
    """The burst's time is up: what is left of it goes at once."""
    if IsValid(self.Burst):
        self.Burst.K2_DestroyComponent(self)


def Fade(From: float, To: float, Seconds: float, Hold: bool):
    """Every local player's camera fades between clear and the flash's colour."""
    GetAllActorsOfClass(self, PlayerController, Players)
    for Each in Players:
        Player = cast(PlayerController, Each)
        if IsValid(Player):
            if Player.IsLocalController() and IsValid(Player.PlayerCameraManager):
                Player.PlayerCameraManager.StartCameraFade(From, To, Seconds, MakeColor(self.FlashRed, self.FlashGreen, self.FlashBlue, 1.0), False, Hold)


def Reveal(Flashed: bool):
    """The Crystal stands where the rift was: on the server it is told to reveal itself (it hides
    the map rift again, on every machine), the red light goes; after a flash, the screen clears."""
    self.Stage = 4
    self.SetActorTickEnabled(False)
    if Flashed:
        self.Fade(1.0, 0.0, self.FlashOutSeconds, False)
    if IsValid(self.Glow):
        self.Glow.SetIntensity(0.0)
        self.Glow.SetVisibility(False, False)
    if IsServer(self) and IsValid(self.Crystal):
        K2_SetTimer(self.Crystal, "Reveal", self.CallDelay, False)

mission.author: NellsRelo
mission.description:
Techne,

Maximillian and I are relocating to investigate continued Orc Army activity. You may be a Weaver, but we're still short handed, and we may need all the help we can get on this one. We've heard reports of strange Rift energies around one of our more... Apprentice Friendly fortresses. Byron will be coming with you. He may be a vampire, but he's on our side. Just don't let him fly away.

- Gabriella
mission.title: North Wings
